resources.string: Use your phone as a webcam
Open Webcam needs access to your camera so it can send the picture to your computer. Nothing is recorded or uploaded to the internet.
Camera access was turned off. Turn it on in Settings → Permissions → Camera.
On your computer, open Open Webcam and pick “%1$s”.
Your phone and computer must be on the same Wi-Fi.
Not showing up? Type this on your computer:
This phone isn’t connected to Wi-Fi. Connect it to the same Wi-Fi as your computer.
On your computer, pick the camera “Open Webcam” in your video call, browser or any other app. You can lock your phone; streaming keeps going.
Your computer can’t find this phone right now.
Only allow computers you own. You’ll only be asked once per computer.
Computers will have to ask again next time.
Open Open Webcam on your computer to connect.
Your camera is being used as a webcam.
